bio: Al dente spaghetti with briny clams and finely chopped parsley, fork-tender ossobuco in a knockout sauce or iconic classics of the likes of vitello tonnato or grandma’s rabbit stew: Chef Luca is a champion of down-to-earth, honest Italian nosh that he crafts with lashings of sensitivity and nuance. Mediterranean tradition sets the tone of the enticing set and à la carte menus, while a buzzy vibe and on the ball, cheerful service underscore this osteria’s warm welcome; the front is cosier than the flower-decked area near the kitchen. Buzzy Osteria Luca has added a cheerful vibrant dimension to this peaceful village....
